ov: اليمن: الحرب الصامتة هو فيلم وثائقي قصير صَدر سنة 2015من إخراج المخرج اليمني سفيان أبولحم. يروي الفيلم الوثائقي قصة حرب اليمن وما جرى خلالها ثم آثارها المدمّرة على الشعب اليمني.
plotEn: The documentary tells the stories of Yemeni refugees living in Markazi Refugee Camp. Since the war started in Yemen in early 2015, more than 3 million people have been internally displaced and around 180,000 have fled the country. Thousands of Yemeni refugees have returned to Yemen preferring the uncertainty of the war over the camps' conditions. According to United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees (UNHCR) Inter-Agency Operation update in October 2017, a total of  2,170 Yemenis remain at the Markazi Refugee Camp in Obock, Djibouti.
